reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004A9CCC was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004A9CCC-Camera_SetFieldOfView_18.cpp at sha256 3098ab46c9e7b44b741701b1193a051cc42d50277866a59e78472646b4a66328 (recorded implementation.signature: void __convention("regparm")(int32_t arg1, long double arg2 @ st0) __pure Camera_SetFieldOfView_18(void);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: Camera_SetFieldOfView_18
retail_function.signature: void __convention("regparm")(int32_t arg1, long double arg2 @ st0) __pure
retail_function.summary: Three blocks 0x4A9CCC-0x4A9CE4: if (EAX & 0x80000) return 7; else st0 += qword [0x5347E0] and return 1. EAX carries the flag, st0 the operand.

candidate_function.signature: void __convention("regparm")(int32_t arg1, long double arg2 @ st0) __pure Camera_SetFieldOfView_18(void);
candidate_function.summary: __convertTOStoQNaN() has an empty body (`return;`); it implements neither the 0x80000 test, nor the 7/1 returns, nor the fadd.

divergences: Candidate body is empty: the EAX&0x80000 branch, both return values (7 and 1) and the st0 += qword [0x5347E0] add are all elided.
Signature loses both inputs (EAX flag, st0 operand) and the EAX result.
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x004A9CCC is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004A9CCC-Camera_SetFieldOfView_18.cpp (sha256 3098ab46c9e7b44b741701b1193a051cc42d50277866a59e78472646b4a66328). Three blocks 0x4A9CCC-0x4A9CE4: if (EAX & 0x80000) return 7; else st0 += qword [0x5347E0] and return 1. EAX carries the flag, st0 the operand. Candidate: __convertTOStoQNaN() has an empty body (`return;`); it implements neither the 0x80000 test, nor the 7/1 returns, nor the fadd.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: Retail takes the flag in EAX and the operand in st0 and returns the integer in EAX; the candidate declares `void ... (void)` with no arguments and no result.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: The EAX flag and st0 operand are both absent from the candidate.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Retail has 3 blocks / 2 edges (test 0x80000, return 7, fadd + return 1); the candidate is a single empty block. The BN pseudocode itself is empty, so the candidate faithfully copied a decompiler elision rather than the retail body.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: 0x80000, 7, 1 and the [0x5347E0] addend are all missing from the candidate.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: The fadd reads the qword global 0x5347E0 in retail; the candidate reads nothing.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Retail returns 7 or 1 in EAX; the candidate returns nothing.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.detail: The st0 += [0x5347E0] floating-point add is missing entirely.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "void __convention("regparm")(int32_t arg1, long double arg2 @ st0) __pure" at 0x004A9CCC; radare2 recovers "fcn.004a9ccc ();". Both tools place the entry at 0x004A9CCC and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: void __convention("regparm")(int32_t arg1, long double arg2 @ st0) __pure Camera_SetFieldOfView_18(void);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.
The candidate defines __convertTOStoQNaN; the catalog name is Camera_SetFieldOfView_18 and the recorded signature does not describe the file.
